title: Spicy Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Saudi cuisine, packed with the heat of spicy ingredients and the richness of umami flavors.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.amount: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add onions, garlic, and red bell pepper to the pot, and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, cayenne pepper, cinnamon, and cardamom to the pot, and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth and soy sauce to the pot, and bring to a boil.
Return chicken to the pot, and reduce heat to low.
Simmer, covered, until chicken is cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
